# Agents, commands, hooks and generated files

## Where things are authored

- Agents: `plugins/<name>/com.github.copilot/agents/<agent>.agent.md`.
- Commands: `plugins/<name>/com.github.copilot/commands/<command>.md`.
- Hooks: `plugins/<name>/com.github.copilot/hooks/hooks.json`. Discourage hooks in shared plugins; their behaviour differs between clients and they are not generated for Claude Code.

## Agent rules

- File name is `<name>.agent.md`, and frontmatter `name` matches it.
- Frontmatter has `name`, `description`, and `tools`.
- `tools` uses only these tool sets: `read`, `search`, `edit`, `execute`, `web`, `todo`. Anything else has no Claude mapping and fails CI.
- Agents stay thin: they find inputs and delegate to a skill. Flag review rules, procedures or domain logic written into an agent; move them into the skill.
- Read-only agents must not list `edit` or `execute`.

## Command rules

- Frontmatter has `description`, and `argument-hint` if it takes input.
- No client-specific argument variables (such as `$ARGUMENTS`) in the body.

## Generated files

These are generated by `scripts/sync_manifests.py` and must never be edited by hand:

- `plugins/<name>/agents/`, `commands/`, `.claude-plugin/`, `.cursor-plugin/`, `.mcp.json`
- `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`, `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json`

If a generated file changes without a matching change to its source in the same PR, flag it as a hand edit. Generated agents and commands start with a `GENERATED from ... Do not edit` note.
